feature_study.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original transparent PNG pixel-art game building sprite for Brokk Town.
Primary request: a cozy studious research cottage / little reading room for Feature Bot, where a bespectacled little robot studies the repository and discovers useful new features. One warm timber-and-cream-stone village cottage with a burgundy roof, prominent pictogram sign showing an open book with a small golden idea-light above it, an open reading nook containing bookshelves and a brass reading lamp, and a compact glasses-wearing gray robot at the desk reading a book. Tiny grass and flowers immediately under the cottage only. Convey thoughtful studious curiosity.
Style/medium: original cozy village-game pixel art, crisp hard stepped pixel clusters, dark navy outlines, top-down three-quarter game perspective with front and right wall visible, warm windows, consistent upper-left lighting. Color palette matches green-roof greenhouse, blue-roof workshop, violet observatory, amber shipping depot and teal watchtower companion sprites. No anti-aliased illustration look. Do not copy any existing game or website.
Composition/framing: one isolated building centered on a square canvas, full building visible, generous empty margin on every side; all sprite pixels fit in central 84 percent of width and height. No other buildings or objects outside its small lawn.
Scene/backdrop: TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Output a genuine RGBA PNG image with alpha=0 outside the cottage and its little lawn. The file MUST contain a real alpha channel. No visible checkerboard. A checkerboard painted into opaque RGB pixels is unacceptable.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, text, logos, watermark, humans, roads, landscape, sky, background glow, black or solid-colored background, grid, borders, duplicate sprites, labels.
